nodes.label: Accessible & Ethical UI Style Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Mandates 4.5:1 minimum contrast, 16px+ text, 3-4px visible focus rings, ARIA labels, skip links, reduced-motion support, and 44x44px touch targets for institutional accessibility.

nodes.label: Forbidden UI Anti-Patterns & Pre-Delivery Checklist
nodes.rationale: Prohibits playful design, hidden credentials, AI purple/pink gradients, emojis as icons, missing cursor:pointer, layout-shifting hovers, and invisible focus states.

nodes.label: Page-Specific Design Override Logic
nodes.rationale: Page-specific specs under design-system/pages/[page-name].md override MASTER.md when present; otherwise MASTER.md rules apply strictly.

nodes.label: ADR-20261126-01: Editorial Anti-AI-Slop Design System, Ponytail & Graphify
nodes.norm_label: adr-20261126-01: editorial anti-ai-slop design system, ponytail & graphify
nodes.rationale: Replaces violet/neon-cyan AI meshes, Sparkles icons, bubble cards, and leaked Slide X deck labels with maritime dress-uniform navy, warm stone, heraldic brass hairline ledgers, ponytail shortcut tracking, and graphify architecture indexing.

nodes.label: Mandatory Session Startup Protocol
nodes.rationale: Agents must read docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, and docs/TASK_LOG.md in order before planning or modifying files to avoid redoing completed work.
